Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

Come sing your favorite classic songs with Kii and Yii! The sing-along starts on Old MacDonald's farm, where the friends learn how to spell the friendly dog's name in the song 'Bingo'! Then, listen as Mr. Cat sings a story about his grand adventure visiting the Queen in her palace. The fun continues with the story of the Lion and the Unicorn, the flying adventure of 'Two Little Dicky Birds' and a song about the Old Woman Who Lived in a Shoe.

Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

Join a month of fun and learning! Go to the petting zoo and lead a group of chicks, then play musical chairs at school. Take your first ballet class, build a crazy bubble machine, and go on an adventure to a prehistoric fantasy land!

Go on a learning adventure at school! Learn shapes, play instruments, and discover why honesty is best. Help Baby John get ready for the day, do the chicken dance, and hunt for dinosaur eggs in the classroom like a real paleontologist!

Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

Join Baby John for a fun day at school with Miss Hannah and all his friends! The learning begins with Arts and Crafts, as the kids use everyday objects to create fun new things. Then, it's time to learn about animals from all around the world! During playtime, Miss Hannah teaches the kids important lessons on how to play nice and fair with each other. From learning about different jobs on career day to putting on a Baby Shark play, every day at school is an adventure!

It's time for fun and games with all our friends! First, Jill is shy at her first mermaid swimming class, but she learns to have fun and trust herself with the help of her friends. Then, during a Mexican posada, Manny teaches Baby John how to build a piñata. After he gets over being a little scared of the blindfold, he has lots of fun! The fun continues as the friends learn to compromise when they have opposite ideas for playtime.

Find out all the fun ways JJ likes to play! First, join JJ, TomTom and YoYo as they spend the day indoors pretending to be doctors and nurses. Then, the fun continues outside! When the kids get restless at a family barbecue, they play a fun game of 'Simon Says.' On another adventure, experienced scouts TomTom and YoYo take JJ under their wing and show him how to do classic outdoor camping activities. From racing grocery carts to a doggy playdate, JJ loves to play!

Join JJ and his animal friends on a big imagination adventure! First, Wally teaches everyone how to sail like real pirates, but they'll need to work together to stay on course! Then, when Mimi gets hungry, she decides the moon must be made of cheese, so the friends build a rocketship to fly there and find out! The adventure continues as they follow a treasure map to find special shape keys and help Little Red Riding JJ avoid Wally Wolf's silly traps in the woods.

Come on and join JJ's fun learning club! The adventure starts with a field trip to the farm where JJ and his friends learn to count to ten using apples. The learning continues in the classroom as Ms. Appleberry sends the kids on a scavenger hunt to find items in every color of the rainbow. Even lunchtime is fun, as the family finds all the different shapes in JJ's lunch! From taking care of pets to learning yoga, there's always something new to learn!

Get ready for JJ's Learning Month! Feel excited for your first day of school, learn your ABCs with blocks, and discover your five senses. Go on a field trip to see ten baby chicks hatch and take a fun ride on the big yellow school bus!
